players.product: Final polishers and grinders for silicon wafer production and compound semiconductor processing; processing equipment for panel-level packaging (PLP) in development

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025, semi-annual report): consolidated net sales JPY 20,117 million (+0.4%), operating profit JPY 885 million (-0.6%), ordinary profit JPY 863 million (+64.4%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 458 million (+46.8%). Semiconductor-related equipment net sales JPY 7,314 million (+34.2%), segment operating profit JPY 1,853 million (+80.1%); machine tools net sales JPY 12,802 million (-12.2%), segment operating loss JPY 301 million (prior-year segment profit JPY 512 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 20,117 million (+0.4%); semiconductor-related equipment JPY 7,314 million (+34.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor-related equipment, H1 (semi-annual report): management states that while capex demand is partly sluggish, silicon wafer inventory adjustment is gradually moving toward normalization and some demand has emerged for wafers for next-generation power semiconductors and next-generation high-frequency communication devices; sales of final polishers and grinders for wafer production to Japan, Europe and East Asia were above the prior year, and orders for final polishers from Japan and East Asia were also above the prior year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Machine tools, H1 (semi-annual report): in China, Okamoto received orders for multiple surface grinders for lens molds driven by rising demand for in-vehicle cameras for EVs and autonomous driving, lifting orders above the prior year, while sales fell after weak orders in the previous year; US sales rose on pull-forward demand ahead of trade-policy changes with orders roughly flat; in Europe orders and sales fell under pressure from US trade policy. Group R&D expense in the half was JPY 79 million.
